baseline._about: Words the learner already knows: everyday Android, plus the system design course.

avoid._about: Words a beginner misreads or that hide who does what.

phrases.the system: name the actor: the model, your backend, AICore
phrases.just a: cut it, or say what it is

token.def: The unit a language model reads and writes: a word, part of a word, a character or a byte.

next-token prediction.def: What the model does: given the text so far, pick the next token, add it, and repeat.

streaming.def: Receiving the answer token by token as it's generated, instead of all at once at the end.

time to first token.def: How long until the first token of the answer arrives: what makes an app feel responsive.

server-sent events.def: A way for a server to send a stream of small events over one open HTTP response.

stateless.def: Keeping nothing between requests: every request must carry everything needed.

context window.def: The text the model can see for one request, including its answer: its working memory.

temperature.def: A setting for how random the choice of next token is: higher is more varied, lower more predictable.

sampling.def: Choosing the next token at random, weighted by how likely the model thinks each one is.

API key.def: A secret that lets whoever holds it call a paid API on your account.

proxy backend.def: Your own server that the app calls; it checks the user, adds the API key, and calls the model.

on-device model.def: A model that runs on the phone itself, with no network call.

AICore.def: Android's system service that runs Gemini Nano on the device and keeps it updated.

obfuscation.def: Scrambling names in code to make it harder to read.

quota.def: A cap on how many requests an app may make in a period.

language model.def: A program trained on huge amounts of text that continues any text you give it.

training.def: How a model learned: shown huge amounts of text and corrected, again and again, at predicting what comes next.

LLM.def: A large language model. Some models run on a device; others are hosted by a provider.

max_tokens.def: The most tokens the model may write in its answer.

messages.def: The conversation sent with each request: a list of turns marked user or assistant.

turn.def: One message in the conversation, marked user (your side) or assistant (the model's).

stop_reason.def: Why the answer ended: end_turn when finished, max_tokens when cut off.

usage.def: The input and output tokens a call used: what you pay for.

probability.def: How likely something is, as a share of 100%.

login token.def: The token your app gets when the user signs in, which proves to your server who they are.

retrieval.def: Selecting evidence from a collection before generating an answer.

TF-IDF.def: A way to weight words using their frequency in a document and how rare they are in a collection.

embedding.def: A list of numbers generated by a model to represent a piece of text.

labeled test set.def: Questions and the preassigned expected evidence or outcomes.

hit at 3.def: Whether the expected result is among the first three returned.

evidence check.def: Comparing answer claims with the material given to the model.
